sloka: किंचिद्वीर्यं तवानार्य यो मां भर्तुरसन्निधौ ।अपहृत्यागतः पाप तेनादृष्टो महात्मना ।। ५.५८.७१ ।।।।
transliteration: kiṁcidvīryaṁ tavānārya yo māṁ bharturasannidhau ।apahṛtyāgataḥ pāpa tenādṛṣṭo mahātmanā ।। 5.58.71 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O ignoble one when my husband was away, you came and abducted me unseen by the great Rama. You do not have even a little courage (to win me through a straight fight).
